hints.title: Build upward
hints.body: Compute the answer for small integers before using them to answer larger ones.

hints.title: Drop the last bit
hints.body: Shifting a number right by one removes its least significant bit.

hints.title: Recurrence
hints.body: The count for `i` is the count for `i >> 1` plus the value of `i & 1`.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
counts = array of length n + 1 filled with 0
for i from 1 to n:
    counts[i] = counts[i >> 1] + (i & 1)
return counts
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
